title: SDLC Quality Threshold Rules
description: Canonical release-blocking quality thresholds for Evolith satellites. These thresholds apply to all SDLC phases where construction or validation occurs.

thresholds.blockingStatement: Coverage below 80% on business logic BLOCKS merge (Phase 3) and RC stamp (Phase 4).
thresholds.measurement: Per-layer coverage measured via Istanbul/JaCoCo with path-based thresholds. Aggregate coverage is insufficient.
thresholds.enforcement: CI enforced via coverageThresholds in jest/istanbul config. Must be configured per layer, not just aggregate.

thresholds.blockingStatement: Methods or functions exceeding cyclomatic complexity of 15 BLOCK merge or RC stamp without refactoring plan or explicit waiver.
thresholds.measurement: Measured via SonarQube, CodeClimate, or equivalent. Enforced in CI.
thresholds.enforcement: SonarQube quality gate fails on new code exceeding complexity threshold.

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Zero High or Critical CVEs tolerated in production releases
thresholds.blockingStatement: Any High or Critical CVE BLOCKS merge, RC stamp, and production release. Medium CVEs require justification.
thresholds.measurement: Measured via GitHub CodeQL, Snyk, or OWASP Dependency-Check. CVE data must be in SARIF format for CI integration.
thresholds.enforcement: CI pipeline fails on High/Critical CVE detection. No bypass without explicit security waiver + Executive Risk Acceptance.

baseline.description: Percentage of code flagged as technical debt vs. healthy code

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Exceeding 5% without approved remediation plan BLOCKS RC stamp
thresholds.blockingStatement: Technical debt ratio > 5% BLOCKS RC stamp unless a remediation plan with explicit timeline and owner is approved.
thresholds.measurement: SonarQube technical debt ratio metric. Tracked per module and aggregate.
thresholds.enforcement: Remediation plan must be documented in issue tracker with due date and accountable owner.

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Materially deviating from 70/20/10 distribution without explanation
thresholds.blockingStatement: Release with materially skewed distribution (e.g., 40% unit / 50% integration) requires written explanation. Not a hard block but must be reviewed.
thresholds.measurement: Test count distribution by type, not by execution time. Istanbul/jest coverage reports used for verification.
thresholds.enforcement: ADR-0018 testing pyramid distribution remains the target shape. Explanation required when materially deviating.

baseline.description: Required when behavior, architecture, API, or operations change

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Missing documentation for behavioral, architectural, API, or operational changes BLOCKS merge or Production Live
thresholds.blockingStatement: Code changes that alter behavior, introduce new API endpoints, change architecture, or modify operations without corresponding documentation BLOCK merge and Production Live.
thresholds.measurement: PR diff includes documentation changes alongside code changes. Reviewer checklist includes documentation review.
thresholds.enforcement: PR template includes documentation checklist. Reviewer approves documentation adequacy.

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Production paths without observable telemetry BLOCK Production Live
thresholds.blockingStatement: Any production API path without traces, structured logs, or metrics BLOCKS Production Live declaration.
thresholds.measurement: OTel collector verified receiving spans and logs from all production services. Grafana/Loki confirms data flowing.
thresholds.enforcement: Deployment pipeline includes observability verification step before Production Live sign-off.

baseline.description: No breaking changes to published API contracts without version bump

thresholds.blockingThreshold: Breaking changes to internal inter-module contracts BLOCK merge
thresholds.blockingStatement: Breaking changes to inter-module (gRPC/REST) contracts BLOCK merge. Consumer-driven contract tests must pass.
thresholds.measurement: Pact or equivalent contract testing framework. Contract version incremented on breaking changes.
thresholds.enforcement: Contract tests run in CI. Failing contract tests block merge regardless of unit test status.

waiverPolicy.description: A waiver may be used only when the organization deliberately accepts a temporary deviation.

exceptions.cves: High/Critical security vulnerabilities cannot be waived in production releases without explicit Executive Risk Acceptance
exceptions.coverage: Business logic coverage below 80% cannot be waived without Architecture Board approval and remediation plan
